# Raspberry Pi Zero 2 W, 64-bit, tuned for boot time.
start_file=start.elf
fixup_file=fixup.dat
kernel=Image
arm_64bit=1

# Full KMS driver. flutter-pi renders through DRM/GBM, so this is mandatory.
# 128 MB CMA out of 512 MB is enough for a 1080p Flutter surface set.
dtoverlay=vc4-kms-v3d,cma-128

# Firmware-side boot time: no rainbow splash, no 1s wait for a magic key,
# no probing for cameras or DSI/DPI displays that are not attached.
boot_delay=0
disable_splash=1
camera_auto_detect=0
display_auto_detect=0
disable_overscan=1

# Nothing here uses the analogue audio block or the ACT LED.
dtparam=audio=off

# Serial console on the GPIO header. Keep this: on a Zero 2 W it is the only
# way to see why a boot failed. Drop `dtoverlay=miniuart-bt` and the console=
# in cmdline.txt once the image is trusted -- it costs ~0.2s.
dtoverlay=miniuart-bt
